title: One rational matrix hitting point for noncommutative formulas
exact_target: For each $n,s\geq 1$, can one deterministically construct in polynomial bit time a single n-tuple of rational matrices of dimension at most $2ns^{2}$ that makes every nonzero size-s noncommutative polynomial formula over every characteristic-zero field nonzero, with polynomially bounded entry bit lengths?
